title: Onboarding pipeline for embedding+reranker variant matrices with drift-aware profiles
creator: Aisha Nambiar
description: Create a repeatable pipeline and signoff process to onboard embedding + reranker model pairs as a single artifact bundle. This ticket covers: defining the variant matrix (quantization, arch, sequence profile), automating profile extraction under drift-aware workloads, publishing a signed performance profile package, and adding deterministic post-admission checks for runtime compatibility. Goal is to reduce manual steps during enrolment, shorten time-to-certify, and prevent regressions when downstream consumers pin profiles.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible pipeline exists that accepts model artifacts (encoder + reranker) and emits a single profile bundle with metadata and SHA-signed provenance

Published profile includes: latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), memory footprint, KV cache behavior, token throughput under three standard sequence distributions, and a recommended quantization profile
Automated drift-aware workload sampler produces representative inputs and is versioned in the profile metadata
Deterministic admission tests run in CI and fail the PR when performance deviates beyond configured gates
Profile bundle is consumable by runtime (runtime-1.24) and a console entry is created with a visualization tab for the matrix
implementation_steps: Design profile schema extension for paired artifacts (encoder+reranker) and variant matrix
Extend artifact manifest generator to include quantization metadata, cross-arch compatibility tags, and workload sampler hash
Build a drift-aware sampler job that replays synthetic + real prompt mixes and captures KV cache utilization
Add performance measurement harness to runner to capture latency percentiles and memory under batching scenarios
Wire up signing step for profile bundles and push to model-catalog storage with immutability flags
Implement CI admission gate that runs lightweight deterministic checks and compares to golden thresholds
Add console profile publishing flow and visualization stub for reviewers
Run canary onboarding on 2 internal model pairs and iterate on thresholds
decisions: Use SHA256 signing for profile provenance; store keys in KMS and rotate per quarter
Default drift-aware sampler will use a 60/30/10 split: short/medium/long sequences to mirror typical production distributions
Admission gates will initially use p95 latency and throughput at target batch sizes as primary signals; memory regressions will be secondary but blocking for >15% increase
Profile bundles will include compatibility tags for CPU/GPU/quantized variants; runtime will choose best-fit fallback when exact variant is unavailable

Inadequate workload sampling causing profiles to miss production edge cases

Compare profile p95/p99 to baseline within ±10% across canaries
Manual review step in console by PM and Runtime owners before final publish
Post-publish monitoring: watch per-route latency and error rates for 72 hours and auto-roll back profile if customer-impacting regressions observed
